body:
Cringe doesn’t even begin to cover it
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260519-2827)
Peter,
Tom Tiffany had a great time at the GOP convention this past weekend.
He accepted the Republican endorsement for governor and debuted some new marketing materials aimed at reinforcing his carefully curated personal brand (pandering to voters with Wisconsin clichés).
“If there was a convention rallying cry,” right-wing blogger David Blaska observed, “it was: ‘Don’t Let Wisconsin Become Minnesota.’”
[__](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260519.piS8Tq&refcode=em20260519-2827&t=1&akid=2827%2E105371%2E5hgXv1)
“Don’t Minnesota My Wisconsin” is one of Tiffany’s longtime favorite lines (never mind the fact that he was born there).
"You Betcha!" is his newest slogan. A rhetorical cream puff!
One problem: It appears to be ripped off. From a [cannabis company](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13078?t=2&akid=2827%2E105371%2E5hgXv1). That’s based in (checks notes) Minnesota. Ope, guess that’s three problems.
_[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260519.piS8Tq&refcode=em20260519-2827&t=3&akid=2827%2E105371%2E5hgXv1)
__This is extremely funny and ironic_
The pandering is insulting; the plagiarism is just ridiculous!
Here is what Tom Tiffany is actually about:
* Voted for Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" — twice.
* Cast the deciding vote to continue Trump's illegal war with Iran.
* Voted to keep Trump's tariffs in place five separate times.
* Voted against extending the Affordable Care Act tax credits
* Voted to block the release of the Epstein files.
* Also, he’s against cannabis legalization.

__
_Nightmare blunt rotation._
Tom Tiffany has millions of dollars in the bank, and he can't even hire a decent marketing agency.

"You Betcha!" is his newest slogan. A rhetorical cream puff! One problem: It appears to be ripped off. From a . That’s based in (checks notes) Minnesota. Ope, guess that’s three problems. This is extremely funny and ironic The pandering is insulting; the plagiarism is just ridiculous! Here is what Tom Tiffany is actually about: Voted for Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" — twice. Cast the deciding vote to continue Trump's illegal war with Iran. Voted to keep Trump's tariffs in place five separate times. Voted against extending the Affordable Care Act tax credits Voted to block the release of the Epstein files. Also, he’s against cannabis legalization. Nightmare blunt rotation. Tom Tiffany has millions of dollars in the bank, and he can't even hire a decent marketing agency. Trump Calls Off Iran Strike

President Trump [revealed Monday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2uozAQhZ_GdKDxADEuXGzjLttuiSZ4SKz1D7KdZe_bX5FHuPU5Op_O9-e-3skHn56_KbIpbV9ddmsr73hwcrlUrgf9bzlFqtXzioC3HuZe6jWFVXbOuM2R3Do2UimN46w1dC-zj6S0wn1-3KTTsLiFpFTEmogANHbeXFMwIwDIEZZhcvv8GEmpSS2jHFlMQIFLGwof70fwG6VG9e-ey8bDlmMXzKu1o4rxl0Ar0J7nOaSv5iPXKxdoL4JAC7NAK_VVySU4gTZ65wIz1SbQ-kKp_zzuG6fqcxpeLYauGHecPgRfb0pM8IzkwwfcfuDpn8HvAAAA__-VlHca) he had postponed a "very major attack" on Iran after Tehran submitted a peace proposal through Pakistan. Gulf state allies -- Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the UAE -- asked for a two-to-three-day pause to allow negotiations to proceed. Trump said [there's a "very good chance"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGurCAYhJ9GOwwCihYUt7Hb297S_PL_umQRDOD17NufuMV5gNNNZpLJfPPvMT_AeRe2v7CTSWWdMeJc0rkfFDCmTPmArxLDDjk7mgUXPeMda8c5-Lmt0aBFaG1NptV6FLIbR14_jRyXRfZAyK3uFIFVqAYObd8No1q7tXbmruKd4Jy3kg-NwrVbJGit9CBbSZXi4CmVJtFxLt5ZCAXya43JUmPjXnvzLOXIlfxTiakS03VdTaKzUMp3fjsxeazEhDGAR_ahYhnemW0xIrNPCJaYSxBYOK0nSAwJPIO10C09vF3YWC7JvYj9oA-VmOpk8Lic9y73ulJ828H5z6zyixf_G_EdAAD__70Fgxg) of a deal limiting Iran's nuclear program. The U.S. military remains at "moment's notice" readiness. Pakistan is serving as the intermediary between Washington and Tehran. The diplomatic opening complicates months of escalation. Trump has repeatedly threatened new strikes since the U.S. war with Iran began in late February. A deal -- if it materializes -- would represent a dramatic reversal, giving the president a foreign policy win [heading into the midterms](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLtuwyAYhZ8Gb1hcbBMPDF28pWtH6zf8TlC5WIBD2qevkkfoeHSkc_R9X9f1Cs67ePuEgDrXfbXJrjWf4cBoUy5YDnjWFAOU4nAVTEyUjZTPa_Qr76y2xgI3HWqu1CzkOM-su2sjN2N2IQGUGSclBwQ1GURAlLOFrXP6NcVGwRjjkl36we7jJkGpQV0kl0gGBh5z7TMe5-adgVihfO8pG-xNCp3X91qPQuQHEQsRS2ut39MzYiuvnojFuwfSVyZieSNRlyHSBpm6kgE9vacczl8aT-MRMrUIngb4ofzSZW2P5rx3ZVJkYLcAzr9_6z80PbT4CwAA___OiHp7). ★★★

Blanche said payments to convicted January 6 defendants are "possible." Senate appropriators pressed Blanche on who qualifies and how decisions will be made. [The fund's structure](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O6yAUhJ_G7hwd_gwUFLdJl9tuaR3gOEHBNgKy2cdfOY-w5WikGX3f1225Ycppv__HjVzt6xKPuPT62grt8aiNWsGffuwbtpZo4cDnCdTE7LLnhY3RxRCRhZEc09pyoayF8eFkMIp5ICa1WiWiFZwZv6p5tsZa6cfkzilQHACYAHORcVVeoNZSG8EEDRIwU-2XSuXlcwq4d2zP9aiBLuHYxuwevZc2iH8Dvw78imWndzurM9SeQqaBXz8sU8Z3e6U-pdqmTPichOY2kjBag1fKeAKmGUcmhRTar2asLpZ3yjm1WQ8S7hum_Pntf9D07fhvAAAA__-AhnTn) gives DOJ broad discretion to decide who receives compensation. ★★★

I’ve spent my career fighting against corruption. But what we’re seeing right now is unlike anything I’ve ever seen before. Let me just catch you up on what just happened. Donald Trump decided to sue the IRS — his own government that he runs — for $10 billion over the leaking of his tax returns during his first administration. But just after a federal judge had ordered both sides to explain why the case didn’t create a massive conflict of interest — because Trump controls both the agency he sued and the lawyers defending it — this took a different turn. His personal lawyers and his DOJ lawyers (remember they’re supposed to be on two different sides in this case) reached a sham settlement where the government agreed to create a $1.8 billion fund to compensate his political allies who believe they’ve been “wrongfully convicted,” potentially including the people who attacked the Capitol on January 6th. All paid for by American taxpayers. This level of corruption is staggering. And it's why I introduced the Ban Presidential Plunder of Taxpayer Funds Act — legislation to make it illegal for a sitting president or vice president to receive settlement payments from the federal government they control — or to direct those payments to a third party. [**Add your name if you want to help put an end to this corruption, stop politicians from rigging the system, and make sure taxpayer dollars are never treated like a personal slush fund again.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpIRS/?source=EW_EMZ31I_COR_ENG_20260519_F&t=8&akid=2906%2E4032634%2EYIyUsV) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpIRS/?source=EW_EMZ31I_COR_ENG_20260519_F&t=9&akid=2906%2E4032634%2EYIyUsV)
---
Look, Trump used the threat of a lawsuit against his own government to pressure nearly $2 billion out of the U.S. Treasury.
No jury decided this. No judge approved it. Congress never voted on it.
It’s like Trump said: _Nice lawsuit I’ve got here. Shame if someone had to keep defending against it... unless there was a payout for my allies._
And what makes this especially outrageous is how the fund was structured. Once the money is transferred, the government’s own order says it has “no liability whatsoever” for what happens next.
No accountability. No oversight. No clawback. Just $1.8 billion flowing into a fund controlled by Trump’s DOJ, to be distributed however they choose to Trump’s allies.
My legislation would ban presidents and vice presidents from collecting settlement payments from the government they control, require transparency and independent oversight, and impose real penalties for abuse.
This legislation draws a hard ethical line: Presidents cannot try to financially benefit from the very government they are controlling.
[**Add your name if you believe no president should be able to turn a sham lawsuit into a billion-dollar cash grab for political allies.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumpIRS/?source=EW_EMZ31I_COR_ENG_20260519_F&t=10&akid=2906%2E4032634%2EYIyUsV)
Thanks for being part of this,
Elizabeth

Donald Trump decided to sue the IRS — his own government that he runs — for $10 billion over the leaking of his tax returns during his first administration. But just after a federal judge had ordered both sides to explain why the case didn’t create a massive conflict of interest — because Trump controls both the agency he sued and the lawyers defending it — this took a different turn. His personal lawyers and his DOJ lawyers (remember they’re supposed to be on two different sides in this case) reached a sham settlement where the government agreed to create a $1.8 billion fund to compensate his political allies who believe they’ve been “wrongfully convicted,” potentially including the people who attacked the Capitol on January 6th. All paid for by American taxpayers. This level of corruption is staggering. And it's why I introduced the Ban Presidential Plunder of Taxpayer Funds Act — legislation to make it illegal for a sitting president or vice president to receive settlement payments from the federal government they control — or to direct those payments to a third party. | Look, Trump used the threat of a lawsuit against his own government to pressure nearly $2 billion out of the U.S. Treasury. No jury decided this. No judge approved it. Congress never voted on it. It’s like Trump said: Nice lawsuit I’ve got here. Shame if someone had to keep defending against it... unless there was a payout for my allies. And what makes this especially outrageous is how the fund was structured. Once the money is transferred, the government’s own order says it has “no liability whatsoever” for what happens next. No accountability. No oversight. No clawback. Just $1.8 billion flowing into a fund controlled by Trump’s DOJ, to be distributed however they choose to Trump’s allies. My legislation would ban presidents and vice presidents from collecting settlement payments from the government they control, require transparency and independent oversight, and impose real penalties for abuse. This legislation draws a hard ethical line: Presidents cannot try to financially benefit from the very government they are controlling. body:
cadem.org [cadem.org]
California Democratic Party Releases Final Edition of California VOTER Index
Today, CADEM released the fifth and final edition of the California VOTER Index [https://cadem.org/california-voter-index/] . The 1,200-sample survey of likely June 2026 voters was conducted May 14-16 online and via phone by EVITARUS [https://evitarus.com/] – the only Black- and Latina-led full service public opinion research firm in California.
The surveys included each candidate’s official ballot designation and party affiliation. In addition, oversamples were completed for Latino, Black and Asian-American voters to avoid small sample sizes and ensure clarity in data results.
Today’s results show voters are highly engaged with 37% saying they have already voted, and of those who have not yet voted, nearly all have a plan to do so.
The survey also shows Republican Steve Hilton garners 22% support (and continues to outpace Chad Bianco's 10% support), and Democrat Xavier Becerra holds 21% of the vote and continues to consolidate support of both Democrats and Independents.
Becerra also currently maintains the broadest coalition of any candidate for Governor with 35% of Democrats—a 6-point increase from May 4th—and 19% of Independents.
Today’s topline survey results show:
* Steve Hilton (R) - 22%
* Xavier Becerra (D) - 21%
* Tom Steyer (D) - 15%
* Chad Bianco (R) - 10%
* Katie Porter (D) - 7%
* Matt Mahan (D) - 4%
* Antonio Villaraigosa (D) - 1%
* Tony Thurmond (D) - 1%
* Betty Yee (D) - <1%
* Eric Swalwell (D) - <1%
You can view today’s topline poll results and crosstabs by clicking here. [https://cadem.org/california-voter-index/]
“My message to California Democrats is simple,” said CADEM Chair Rusty Hicks . “Cast your ballot today and ensure your vote is counted in this important election.”
The California VOTER Index follows an open letter [https://cadem.org/open-letter-to-the-democratic-candidates-for-governor/] sent by Chair Rusty Hicks to Democratic candidates for Governor, including those who subsequently filed for the Primary Election ballot. CADEM launched the California VOTER Index [https://cadem.org/cadem-chair-rusty-hicks-launches-california-voter-index-to-track-governors-race/] to help all candidates honestly assess their viable path to win.

subject: Please help me prove them wrong
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail
body:
They think that if they throw enough at us, our movement will lose steam before November.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)
Friend,
The GOP is making a bet right now.
They think that if they throw enough at us – enough smears, enough distractions, enough outside money – our grassroots movement will lose momentum before November. They think supporters like you will tune out.
I need your help to prove them wrong. Not with hours of your time. Just this:
So please: [**Add your name to personally endorse my campaign for Congress >>**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-may26-personal-endorse/?source=em260519-1-b&refcode2=2220.791427.loNL6O&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)
**[ADD MY NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-may26-personal-endorse/?source=em260519-1-b&refcode2=2220.791427.loNL6O&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)**
Because here’s what’s actually happening in the real world while they try to undermine us:
Groceries _cost more._ Gas _costs more._ Rent _costs more._
Trump blew up decades of trade relationships overnight, despite economists warning that it would hit working families the hardest. He’s dragged us into a war with Iran that has made prices at the pump skyrocket – with no plan in place and no vote from Congress.
And through all of it, Trump’s only consistent priority has been to hand his billionaire family and their billionaire friends massive tax cuts.
Working families across the country are facing the consequences of every reckless decision this administration makes.
Families across the country see it. They’re living with it. And they need someone in Congress who will fight back every single day without backing down.
By adding your name right now, you make it clear that we see exactly what’s happening, and we are not backing down.
So: [**will you please take a minute and personally endorse my reelection campaign? This small and simple action goes a long way in showing the GOP just how strong our movement is.** **[ADD MY NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-may26-personal-endorse/?source=em260519-1-b&refcode2=2220.791427.loNL6O&akid=2220%2E791427%2EloNL6O)** In solidarity, Ilhan

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: The Dems are at war. Rubio just opened a 16-point lead.
body:
Plus: $165 billion Project Jupiter is coming. Here's the catch | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/FAv8YZ3CcoO?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Marco Rubio just opened a 16-point lead over JD Vance for 2028.
Meanwhile a former Democratic governor went on national TV and torched her own party. A former Albuquerque mayor went after a fellow Democrat in the Journal. AOC is leading the Democratic primary at 26%. One party is finding its next leader. The other is still fighting over its last one.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/NgwfvnyRVSY?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🚨 **DEMOCRATS ARE AT WAR WITH THEMSELVES**
Christine Gregoire — former Washington governor — went on national TV and torched her own party. The four-word phrase she used about Democratic spending should end up in every GOP ad this cycle.
Then former Albuquerque Mayor Marty Chavez wrote an op-ed going after Sam Bregman in the Journal. Democrat-on-Democrat, in print.
And the 2028 Democratic field? AOC 26. Buttigieg 22. Newsom 21. Harris 12.
**Their frontrunner has never run anything.

** 🔥 **RUBIO 45, VANCE 29 — A 22-POINT SWING IN FIVE MONTHS**
Five months ago, JD Vance led Marco Rubio by 24 points. Now Rubio leads by 16.
Vance has been quiet. Rubio has been everywhere. Then Trump went to the Rose Garden and floated a Vance-Rubio "dream team" ticket.
The crowd's reaction tells you everything.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/vRKwgaEMShD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
💰 **$165 BILLION IS COMING TO DOÑA ANA COUNTY**
Project Jupiter. Oracle. OpenAI. A 1,400-acre AI data center campus in Santa Teresa.
Seven in 10 Americans say they oppose AI data centers near where they live. A separate project near Fort Bliss would need more power than every El Paso Electric customer combined.
That's the number that should stop you cold.
Florida's Ron DeSantis is doing this differently. Mark walks through what Santa Fe should be studying — before the next one lands here.

🇨🇳 **A CHINESE SPY WAS ELECTED MAYOR. NBC IS WORRIED ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE.**
Eileen Wang, mayor of Arcadia, California, just pleaded guilty to acting as an illegal agent of the Chinese government.
NBC's tweet didn't lead with the espionage. It led with "anti-Asian discrimination" concerns. We walk through, line by line, how a major network frames a story like this.

🎬 **TMZ TRIED TO BURY SPENCER PRATT. HE DIDN'T BLINK.**
Harvey Levin spent ten minutes trying to get the LA mayoral candidate to admit the Airstream on his burned-out Pacific Palisades lot isn't really his house. Pratt's response is the part we want you to see.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/qujmisUZwh4?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
PLUS: Three NM Republican write-ins (Larry Marker, Joshua Lawrence, James Ellison) each need 2,351 votes to make the November ballot. Jim Jordan on CNN with Kaitlan Collins — it does not go well. A septic truck loses a fight with a train in Virginia. And a bear manhandles Mark's trail camera.

body:
This is reckless.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)
Right now, the Trump administration is pushing a proposal that would allow **handguns to be shipped through the U.S. Postal Service** for the first time since 1927.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=2&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)
[**Will you add your name to our petition and join Sarah McBride in opposing this dangerous plan to allow handguns to be sent through the Postal Service?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=3&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)
**[Add Your Name »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=4&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)**
At a moment when gun violence continues to devastate families and communities in Delaware and across the country, Donald Trump wants to make it easier to mail handguns across state lines. **That’s absolutely reckless.**
This proposal could weaken background check systems, make firearms harder to track, and loosen oversight of the firearm industry — all to hand the gun lobby another win.
**And here’s the thing: the Trump administration is betting that we’re not paying attention.** They're counting on people being too exhausted by the daily chaos to notice this dangerous move, and that no one will speak up until it’s too late.
But Delawareans sent Sarah to Congress to fight for gun safety — not stand by while extreme politicians make it easier for weapons to move across the country.
That’s why Sarah is opposing this rollback of federal safety protections and urging Congress to do more to protect our families, our kids, and our communities from gun violence.
[**We need your voice to help us show strong public opposition to this proposal. Will you add your name to join our fight?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/em-20260519-2-usps-proposal/?source=em20260519-3288&t=5&akid=3288%2E21716%2Eg3xWjB)

Team McBride

Dear friends,
California Democrats are organized, energized, and ready to win on June 2nd.
Across the state, organizers are knocking doors, volunteers are making calls, and local teams are mobilizing voters in the districts that will decide the future of the House Majority.
And the momentum is real. We’re seeing incredible energy in key battleground districts:
➡️ CA-48
➡️ CA-22
➡️ CA-13
➡️ CA-47
➡️ CA-45
➡️ CA-27These are some of the most competitive races anywhere in the country. And right now, California Democrats are doing the work needed to win them.
Our organizers are on the ground every single day:
✔️ Recruiting and training volunteers;
✔️ Talking directly to voters at the doors and on the phones;
✔️ Building turnout operations before ballots are cast;
✔️ Expanding our outreach in communities that will decide this election.
Republicans are already flooding these districts with attacks, misinformation, and outside money because they know what we do in California will determine control of Congress.
But we know something they don’t: Grassroots organizing can overcome dark money.
We’ve spent months preparing for this primary. We have been on the ground since January. We didn’t wait until the last minute. We built the infrastructure, expanded our volunteer programs, and invested in year-round organizing through our Forever Organizing initiative, not only to be prepared, but to build lasting power and impact in communities across the state that will continue long after Election Day.
Now, with the June 2 Primary Election approaching fast, we’re seeing Democrats across California stepping up with incredible energy and determination.
The path to taking back the House runs straight through California. And the strength of our organizing right now should give every Democrat hope.
If you want to help us keep this momentum going through Election Day, there are TWO ways you can help today:
1) You can sign up to volunteer [https://linktr.ee/cadem] and help reach swing voters and get out the vote for Democrats up and down the state;
2) You can chip in below to support our organizing efforts in battleground districts across the state. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26?&refcode=&amount=]
CHIP IN $ >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26?&refcode=&amount=]We’re almost at the finish line. Join us for our final push these last two weeks and let’s win this, together!
- The entire team at CADEM HQ

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

BREAKING news, Peter:

Justice Democrat Chris Rabb just won the Democratic primary for
Pennsylvania’s 3rd congressional district by over 10 points in a
landslide!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260519-2.wlvP5l&refcode=em20260519-37796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37796%2E1203867%2EIUgYsw ]Congratulations PA-03 Primary 2026 WINNER Justice Democrat Chris Rabb

This is a massive upset for the Democratic machine in Pennsylvania, and a
huge win for our progressive movement nationwide. Instead of electing an
establishment pick, the people of Philadelphia chose to send a bold,
progressive leader to represent the bluest district in the country. It’s
about time!

Chris will now join Rep. Summer Lee as the second Justice Democrat from PA
in Congress, and we couldn’t be more proud.

Despite being up against over $3 million in spending primarily from 314
Action Fund — a PAC previously used by AIPAC as a pass-through — Chris and
his people-powered team out-organized his opposition to build the broadest
coalition of local leaders, grassroots organizations, and national
progressives to win this race.

From the very beginning, Chris ran an uncompromising campaign to end
pay-to-play politics and build a government that answers to its voters,
not billionaires and corporate lobbyists.

And unlike his opponents, he never shied away from calling what Israel is
doing in Gaza a genocide, and proudly rejected contributions from AIPAC
and corporate PACs.

Chris is exactly what Democratic voters nationwide are demanding —
progressive trailblazers who fight for their communities, not just when
it's politically convenient but when it's morally necessary.

While the party machine has spent decades failing to meet the needs of its
voters, Chris has taken the fight to corporate interests, billionaire
CEOs, and Republican extremists his whole career.

Anchored by grassroots organizing on the ground from Pittsburgh to Philly,
together alongside Summer Lee and Chris Rabb, we are ensuring a new,
powerful progressive movement leads Pennsylvania towards the future it
deserves.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260519-2.wlvP5l&refcode=em20260519-37796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37796%2E1203867%2EIUgYsw ]As we celebrate this momentous victory, help us deliver more losses to

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260519-2.wlvP5l&refcode=em20260519-37796&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=37796%2E1203867%2EIUgYsw ]Contribute $5

Thanks again for everything you did to rally around Chris and expand our

and New Jersey, two weeks from today!

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas

## Trump Halts Iran Strike at Last Minute
President Trump said he was "[an hour away](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQRp8Gd0R4_F9Q3IYut93SwjCOZ4PBgkmsvP3K-wpbf9Knc87Xfb5bChQf_-2Omtc0RzxLQGbMM2UbT5ttZlrJkQ1uI_fEiDMo6KXqJKjZWwqfua28XhEBmwp1PQwTDHXfNtWmR-V7hWC7pfXTOtnV9apZxhb9UrfLCBXp6011oGqlBlA3O9Vd76axHsbBgxtEq9ATp3z7ThR5wzV80hvzzaW9CnpjPopo_gkwAkz8HKnwNQkw17EAozoBpp4EmFeRl58Aw_m1HzLjG20ockundCEVlBvK0xbJSWYsfKnHhyyc6YlFpiivJgJMlbU_TgqBSn8BPnZL4ReI_1TxreEnAAD__zGfhe0)" from striking Iran before calling off the attack Monday at the Gulf allies' request. Vice President JD Vance said the administration is "[locked and loaded](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkT-P3CAQxT8N7ljhwX8LFyslK6W4VFFSWhMY1nPGYGFufdvks0f2NulTvR_z0KD3-PU2viF7DvfvuNCQXRwD7ZunnCmNnDDsmDBldmwYvZnYzBRoBAWNVLUENVpk_xyrwg6OCEgXNJRt20NbNpUupqGyCJW21ipCp6BpfytX6tZUWnVgqC94OLapGlSpVAvqgn1ZN6bvyrZrLZhWVIos55gu75FDnsj5Z3xQupi4FH6Ycl43oa8CbgJu-75fXPw8Uhy-gJvnB8njLOCW08eyygl93uSC7zFJzBnNLGOQR1q55cQzyfBhPGGSO-EawybXFO8JF7ngU5a9AC309Y_Q10yfWegvPzEYElCD2vC5nfDjeOkkfg0E1F9BQN0d1Hc-mpns6WB4qY9oz9E_9_rTieGUbwlfwO6UjH5-LXfIvkiDXXf2nrfm6Oy-IPuzo_xfH_sY4G8AAAD__0cGsBw)" to resume strikes if talks collapse, and Trump gave Tehran two or three days to make a deal. U.S. forces have [turned away 88 ships](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOszAQRp8GOiMzXF24-Bu6_O2WaBiGMBtzke3EytuviPYNth7N0Tnf1228oTjZ7_9xYxuXY9w5Bccxsh_F457Qo4-yCAk6WoUevPMIGlqlGwV6nFHce6zz2S7MwFXOtuw6A13Z1lW-2rIGg41GNGWlm3Zp-mUxdU-m6pFgolzsRdMN6FLrDnSBpmxaMn3Z9d0M1GW15lni4YvvQ_a48uLex4t9QceWO7vGeIas-pfBkMGQUipoClfFdc9gcPJi9TxnjBwyGK4oldCr6J_bqU5GYjUzOoUxIj3UeYQgk-MPrzqPEH-_VT0Zaqmn3Nv5TOKchPayu28o7mMT_zThy8JPAAAA__9guoXx) under a naval blockade of Iranian ports, the head of U.S. Central Command told House lawmakers. Iranian state TV ramped up propaganda, with one anchor [firing an AK-47](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCngS5ovQYbFy7-hi5_eyXa4HXYOwdHjgWXtz9xr3D1SN9o5uM6X0mSbPf_9GBfY543Pl6Ja-UyS6HtoEKlSpRFKC2rLF-88YyA5gLDBWEOJOk9923wkRlZt-yVtQ6tMr1uV08WWJtAowkq3MYbWOMoattHFXqOsRV_ajAgKACL0JFTg1ncqOxoAy626YGD1Fy6zyxbXTmmd965dEt-tMmvtT5fjf7X4NTgdBxHF_P3ueLMG5x2CZwbnIx2g3M9glYK2-LD85CU5GXOgvuDJP2C9U8v7B5_AgAA___E-W7c) in the studio after weapons training from a Revolutionary Guard member.
## Mosque Guard Hailed for Saving Lives
Amin Abdullah, the security guard killed Monday at the Islamic Center of San Diego, was a father of eight who [stepped between two teenage gunmen](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAURJ8GOiP_gZfCRRq6L21KdGNfw80ae2ObRfv2EVHeIN2RRhqdmR9f6xdQpLR9hwNtC3lNeNWIrWFZqUC6oEBpFMgRRLeTe2LCVXI5MT4yyVcPFD-r7r0NiBJVj1YYM0sjJq363XLlYdZ8MpMOszbjKIJSs-YigDIuiJ7s3cZHyQXnRvIBZjFObn4I8zBeOtNpjp5aLsOvTKntGOInv7EMLh99tHtrr9qpb51cOrlc1zWkn-5eceedXG7s5HJW9o92LJkcq-jOQu3DthOKZ0-KET17ldzQNUobcztFXzCx2iAEViExT7hlduT6-2TFJVB6fCjRF-tfF8VIdbpttwMo_rVr_3Xp28o_AQAA___O1owR) and more than a dozen children inside. _"It's fair to say his actions were heroic. Undoubtedly, he saved lives today,"_ [said San Diego Police Chief](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFu9CAUBODT4A4LnrGxC4q_cbd_m9Ji4bF-CYYVRkv29pFzhdQjzXyaj9t2sxQpPf7bA00NeUvYzoi1Ytmo2NRssaVSIEc2up3cFybcQMDExchBbN5SfG-q8yYgAg4dGqn1AlpOauh2I1GHUXg_zZMYFhW8d7MM90Vq5e5a647M1SZGEFIIDaK3ixwnt8xSz9qD00wJ9FRz6T8zpbpjiO_8wtK7fHTR7LU-Tzb8Y7AyWFtrffsmknDFDNZL7yIyWE-buCd8ZG5dpRfyc8-5YuF0RnuQ4w5TxcJg1XJQUqixK8Y_G8VI53QxHoel-Dtb__TVy8BPAAAA__9mcHzd) Scott Wahl. A family fundraising effort has [topped $2 million](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ_G7mLhJRi7oPgbd_nbK9EGFnsvxEQEBfntT9wrXDfSSN_om6-bvSFHPrb_-CRTQrIH1XekUihbznhUzJgLB3aM0e3sHnSQBQHTRagLCOuR42mvvTeBCEj2ZEatF9DjdJX9bmYtFQYVFBFJMU5aS5y1kyKgXLxSPZtGEwrEKIQGMeAyqskt86hn7cHp7irIc0l5-E58lJ1CPNOH8uDSs49mL-X17uS_DtYO1lrrcL-71nWwNpkO1mbgIrXo4vmS2yPXbUl9Nv5VOUZ-T21leyLHX2r50xUfAz8BAAD__xEiceg), and worshippers described him as a mosque fixture for over a decade who greeted every visitor with a smile, including the homeless and elderly. The other victims, Mansour Kaziha and Nader Awad, also died confronting the gunmen. The teenage attackers, [Cain Clark and Caleb Velasquez](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy2yAQRb8GdXhgZQm5oEhD99Km1KxgJW2MwAFsj_P1GeUXXn1nzpxzf33NX8iR0_YTD7JtzXOid43UGpWZC6Y3FiyNV_aM0e_s75RoBgWjVIMENQfk-JmvXbArEVDfkdXG3MDo8dp3uzV6CuNCy6qXtafJTAauevK9Vh6XAGPH9qSpAZRWyoC64E0Po79N2kwmgDfiqihwy-XyO3NqO63xk19ULj4fXbR7a48q-h8CnACXPo9c2zkJcCdYgFODAKcnAe5Z5dknwFVMMjBtWR65_nmSrHvOjdMmMUbaKMjtmQ5KkgOls5-CxCo9cpI-YrlLTEF6jLTIF0U8GX8FuK7Y8HhzjFzH03w7kON_0_ate18W_gUAAP__qbKPAg), killed themselves nearby; investigators found anti-Islamic writings and Nazi imagery.
## What's America's Favorite Pizza Chain?
A [new YouGov survey](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCngc7IbADHhYtr6HLtlWhjr8NejB3ZPrjk6X_xv8JfjzT6Zv7clhty4Pj4jRuZ6tMS6SiBaqW8cMZ4YMZc2bNlDHZl-6RIC0iYhBwFyMUhh_cytM54IqBLS6ZXSoPqp-HSrgat7uXdapwI3RXsqLV18q784L3uJ9-yOdvkCLKXUoHsUPfjZPW1V1flwKpmkOS4ptz9TRzrSj680065s2lrg1lrfZXm8quBuYH5OI7Op__nijNvYPYpOeEyx2cDM26U2WIRdypVVCyV40O8-PNBYVfkKFJwotg1pSA87ilzJVH-5Z3ewnN0pc3GvQ4Ogct00h4bcvim1B_9txv4CgAA___CCYfc) ranking America's favorite pizza chains named Pizza Hut as the No. 1 chain, edging out Domino's among 44,000 diners. Pizza Hut won 19.1% of the vote to Domino's 17.1%. Papa John's came in third at 11.4%, Little Caesars fourth at 5.3%, and Marco's Pizza [rounded out the top five](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2S4yAQhJ9GylAN6AcpILjEmS-9UDUHgzW7CFQIm7Kffst-hc27uvv7_l3XK3LgePuLO5ni0xqpnoFKobxyxlgxYy7s2TIGu7H9pkirAjUJGIWC1SGH5zq0zngiRX1LRmq9KC2noW83o3u79OhGkDDOWv53Q2_dLJGAPOHgWzbvNhgVSACtoMNFjpNdZqln7ZTVzQDkuKTcfSWOZSMfnulBubNpb4PZSjnOpv_TqEujLrXWzqfkMLrKkd6ZRl32dBZxpOMeMIuDXy8UdkOOp-AocKfMFsUz3W_pITIdKRfxQZRy0ROAbrNxR-UQ-Jzef247cvjsl19Jexj1EwAA__-x3oEa) with 4.7%, based on responses collected from March 2025 through February 2026. Researchers attributed Pizza Hut's lead to a [nostalgia factor](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAQRb8Gd6xg1ga7oEhD99KmtCZ4eJ4EYwt4Xnm_PnLyCanv1dHR-fExfyAnzp_fcSPX4j5netVErVGZuWB-YcHSOHJgTGHl8JsyzaDASDVIUPOCnK657xYXiYCeHTlt7QRWm_7ZrW4y2kREFcNoIo2gB2P6YewX24-kf6qO3U1TAyitlAX1wEkPJkyjtqNdIFjRK1q47eXxa-fcVorp2k8qj7BvXXJra0cVz28CvACfr2Ov7Z4E-BsswKtBgNeTAJ84Um1XIgH-4Pcb5frVZMaNqsSNCgesMuK5F24k_z3Cipxl_SonXQJ8V9xyvDglruZW-9yQ01-V9l_9Tgd_AgAA__-F-YN2) that resonates with older Americans, many of whom recall the chain's vintage restaurants. More than one in five respondents skipped the national chains entirely and chose a local or regional pizzeria.
